title: Safety clearances
intro: For each role, the safety-critical skills, the minimum level required and, where needed, a currently valid certificate. A person is cleared only when every requirement is met — a skill that was never assessed blocks the clearance; it is never counted as level 0.
kpi_not_configured: People whose role has no requirement
kpi_blocked_observe: of which {{count}} in observe mode (access not closed)
blocked_none: Nobody is blocked in this scope.
expiring_none: No certificate expires within the warning window.
config_intro: A rule applies to everyone in a role, on every site or on one site. When several rules target the same skill, the strictest applies. A rule is never deleted: it is deactivated with a reason.
rules_none: No critical skill is configured: nobody can be declared cleared.
f_cert_required: A currently valid certificate is mandatory
f_warning_days: Warn when a certificate expires within (days)
f_webhook_secret_keep: Leave empty to keep the current secret
f_webhook_enabled: Send a notification on every status change
webhook_help: Every call is signed: header X-IDevelop-Signature = sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body), timestamp in X-IDevelop-Timestamp. Failures are retried with increasing delay. Private or internal addresses are refused.
api_help: Read by permit-to-work or access-control systems: GET /v2/safety-gate/status/<employee number> or GET /v2/safety-gate/status?site=<site>, with an API key carrying the "safety.read" scope. The answer holds only the status, reason codes and expiry dates. "cleared" is true for Cleared, and for Blocked when only observe-mode rules block (the answer then carries "observe": true). NOT_CONFIGURED means no requirement is defined for the role: it is not a denial, the calling system applies its own rule. WAIVED means a time-limited human waiver covers every blocking reason: "cleared" is true, together with "waived": true and "waiverExpiresAt" (when the waiver ends). It is never reported as a plain CLEARED.
not_configured_is_not_denial: "Not configured" is not a denial: no requirement is defined for these roles, the permit-to-work system applies its own rule.
reason_level_not_validated: Level not validated by the manager (self-rating only)
mode_intro: A new rule starts in observe mode: the status is computed and shown, but the API keeps answering "cleared" with the "observe" flag. Switch it to enforce once the impact is checked.
scope_note: You can configure rules for the sites in your scope. Rules for every site and the warning and webhook settings belong to the super administrator.
no_manageable_site: No site in your scope can receive a rule.
f_mode_help: Observe: computed and shown, access not closed. Enforce: closes access.
f_require_validated: Manager-validated level required (a self-rating alone is not enough)
f_max_age_help: Empty: no limit. Beyond it, the assessment no longer proves the level.
confirm_to_enforce: Switch this rule to enforce? The people it blocks will no longer be cleared for the permit-to-work system.
preview_title: Impact of the rule before saving
preview_newly_blocked: {{count}} person(s) would become blocked out of {{total}} evaluated.
preview_already_blocked: {{count}} person(s) are already blocked for other reasons.
preview_observe_note: In observe mode, these people will show as blocked without their access being closed.
preview_enforce_note: In enforce mode, these people will no longer be cleared as soon as the rule is saved.
settings_superadmin_only: These settings apply to the whole organisation: only the super administrator can change them.
notif_plan: See your development plan for the next steps.
err_forbidden: This action is outside your scope: settings and rules for every site belong to the super administrator; a site rule requires that site to be in your scope.
err_bad_max_age: The maximum assessment age must be a whole number of months between 1 and 120.
err_bad_days: The warning window must be between 1 and 365 days.
err_secret_required: A signing secret is required to enable the webhook.
err_private_address: This URL points to a private or internal address: refused.
err_dns: The URL host name does not resolve.
err_bad_level: The minimum level must be between 1 and 4.
err_duplicate_rule: An active rule already exists for this role, site and skill.
err_reason_required: A reason for the deactivation is required.
err_not_found: Rule not found or already deactivated.
legal_badge: Required by law — cannot be waived
legal_no_waiver: At least one reason comes from a rule required by law, which no waiver can lift. If the data is wrong, a contest can have it corrected.
waiver_confirm: Grant this waiver? The person will be authorised by waiver for these hours only. The decision is logged, and the person and their manager are told.
waived_intro: A waiver is granted by the person’s manager or by HSE, for one skill and {{max}} hours at most, and can be renewed once. When it ends, the computed status comes back on its own.
waived_none: No waiver is running for the people you can see.
waiver_no_more_renewal: Already renewed once: it cannot be renewed again.
contests_none: No contest is waiting for the people you can see.
decision_pointer: What must be corrected (for a correction)
decision_pointer_ph: For example: certificate to re-enter, assessment to redo…
f_legally_mandatory: Required by law (no waiver can lift it)
f_legally_mandatory_help: A rule marked this way can never be waived and always stays enforced. Only a SuperAdmin can remove the mark, and must give a reason.
confirm_mark_legal: Mark this rule as required by law? Any waiver running on this skill for the people it covers ends at once.
waiver_granted: Waiver granted. The person and their manager have been told.
waiver_revoked: Waiver ended. The computed status applies again.
contest_submitted: Contest sent to HSE and HR for a decision.
contest_decided: Decision recorded. The person has been told.
me_intro: Your status for safety-critical work, worked out from your assessments and certificates. If you think a block is wrong, you can contest it: someone from HSE or HR reviews it and records a decision with a reason.
me_none: There is no status for your account.
me_contest_help: Say why the block looks wrong (a certificate you hold that was never entered, an assessment that is out of date…). You can have one open contest at a time.
notif_waiver_body: {{skill}}: authorised by waiver until {{date}}. After that, the computed status applies again.
notif_waiver_ended_body: The waiver is over. Status now: {{status}}
notif_contest_review: A safety clearance contest needs your decision
notif_contest_decided: Your safety clearance contest has a decision
notif_contest_upheld: The block is kept. The reason is on your safety clearance page.
notif_contest_overturned_waiver: The block is lifted by a waiver until {{date}}.
notif_contest_overturned_correction: The block is lifted: some data has to be corrected. The details are on your safety clearance page.
err_bad_hours: A waiver lasts a whole number of hours, from 1 to 72.
err_not_waivable: A person who is no longer active cannot get a waiver.
err_not_blocking: This skill does not block the person under an enforced rule right now, so no waiver is needed.
err_legally_mandatory: No waiver: this requirement is set by law and cannot be waived. Only a valid certificate restores the clearance.
err_waiver_exists: A waiver is already running for this skill. Renew it instead if needed.
err_renewal_exhausted: This waiver was already renewed once. No new waiver for this skill is possible for 72 hours.
err_waiver_not_running: This waiver is no longer running.
err_not_blocked: Only a status blocked by an enforced rule can be contested.
err_contest_exists: This person already has an open contest.
err_contest_closed: This contest already has a decision.
err_self_decision: You cannot decide a contest about yourself or one you raised.
err_bad_decision: Choose whether to keep or lift the block.
err_bad_remedy: To lift the block, choose a time-limited waiver or a data correction.
err_pointer_required: Say which data must be corrected.
err_reason_required_waiver: Give a reason for the waiver.
err_reason_required_waiver_end: Give a reason for ending the waiver early.
err_reason_required_contest: Give a reason for the contest.
err_reason_required_decision: Give a reason for the decision.
err_mode_reason_required: Give a reason for switching this rule to observe: the gate will no longer close on it.
err_mode_legally_mandatory: Refused: this rule is required by law and cannot be switched to observe. It stays enforced.
err_waiver_cooldown: A waiver for this person and skill ended less than 72 hours ago. A new one is possible once those 72 hours have passed.
err_waiver_cap: Refused: a person can be waived for at most 144 hours per skill over any 30 days, and this would go over.
err_forbidden_waiver: You cannot grant, renew or end a waiver for this person. Only their direct manager, or someone from HSE whose scope includes them, can do so, and never the person themselves.
err_forbidden_contest: You cannot contest this person’s status. Only the person or their direct manager can.
err_forbidden_decision: You cannot decide this contest. Someone from HSE whose scope includes this person decides it.

ops_recompute_never: The nightly recompute of the gate has not run yet.
ops_certs_nc: No required certificate is set up for these people.
ops_k40_sub: Waivers of the safety gate running today, and the contests of a block.
ops_k40_nc: No role is under an enforced safety rule, and no waiver was ever granted.

ops_k41_gaps: Weeks without a nightly recompute: {{n}}. They show as « Not measured », never as 0.
ops_k41_unmeasured: The gate has no history yet for these people.
ops_k41_nc: No role is under an enforced safety rule.

ops_k42_none: No required certificate expires in the next 12 months.
ops_k42_nodate: Required certificates on record without an expiry date, counted apart: {{n}}

ops_k44_sub: Required certificates on record that carry what an audit asks for.
